rule.text: one proof per held-out August row r in 600..=711; base = OFFSETS[(r - 600) mod 5], OFFSETS = [-2, +2, -15, +15, +30]; offset = base when 0 <= r + base < 712 (offset_rule = direct, public byte 11 = 0), else offset = -base (offset_rule = mirrored, byte 11 = 1; rows 684, 689, 694, 699, 704, 709 at +30 mirror to -30, 698, 703, 708 at +15 to -15, 711 at +2 to -2); u = r + offset; every outcome published, negative and zero differences included
